stories.title: Drawquariumâ€™s human-made trailer drives a breakout wishlist surge
paragraphs: Drawquarium is an upcoming sandbox game where players draw fish, raise them, and build an aquarium. Creative Bloq reports that its release-date trailer helped it gain thousands of wishlists in days.

Developer Kaleb Lechowski said on Steam that the trailer and creator campaign brought 65,000 wishlists in a week, alongside millions of views across IGN, social media, and creator posts. Those totals are developer-reported and do not show sales.
